SELECT * FROM reagent_catalog WHERE is_deleted = 0
AND his_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.hisCode}, '%')
AND generic_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.genericName}, '%')
AND udi_di LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.udiDi}, '%')
AND registration_cert_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.registrationCertNo}, '%')
AND manufacturer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.manufacturer}, '%')
AND distributor LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.distributor}, '%')
AND material_type = #{query.materialType}
AND approval_status = #{query.approvalStatus}
AND test_groups LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.testGroups}, '%')
AND (id IN (SELECT reagent_id FROM dept_reagent WHERE dept_id = #{query.deptId}) OR test_groups IS NULL OR test_groups = '')
ORDER BY updated_at DESC
